description:
Embedded AI and ML Engineer, Mid The Opportunity:  
 As a programmer, you know that machine learning is critical to understanding and processing massive datasets. Your ability to conduct statistical analyses, develop production-ready software, and apply machine learning techniques makes you an integral part of delivering customer-focused solutions. We need your technical knowledge and desire to problem-solve to develop secure, reliable AI capabilities that turn complex data into timely, actionable information.

 As a machine learning engineer on our national security team, you’ll train, test, deploy, and maintain models that learn from data. You’ll develop AI and machine learning capabilities for cloud, edge, and resource-constrained environments, helping users apply advanced analytics where speed, reliability, and mission relevance matter most.

 In this role, you’ll contribute to the direction of critical solutions by applying best-fit machine learning algorithms, software architectures, and deployment technologies. You’ll grow within a talented team of machine learning engineers across the company and collaborate with data scientists, software developers, data engineers, systems engineers, cybersecurity specialists, solutions architects, product owners, and mission experts.

 You’ll design and evaluate machine learning workflows, integrate models into operational software, and build repeatable pipelines for training, deployment, monitoring, and sustainment. You’ll also explore emerging capabilities in generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, natural language processing, computer vision, multimodal AI, and autonomous systems. Your work will help move solutions from experimentation and prototyping into secure, scalable, and supportable environments.

 Your skills and technical experience will help clients navigate the landscape of machine learning algorithms, tools, frameworks, and infrastructure while balancing model performance, computing constraints, cybersecurity requirements, and user needs.

 Work with us to solve real-world national security challenges and define practical AI and machine learning strategies for defense missions.

 Join us. The world can’t wait.

 You Have: 
 5+ years of experience developing software, data science solutions, or machine learning capabilities using Python, Java, or C++
 3+ years of experience designing, training, testing, or deploying machine learning or deep learning models
 2+ years of experience with at least one machine learning framework, including PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face
 Experience deploying containerized applications or machine learning services using Docker, Kubernetes, or REST APIs
 Knowledge of machine learning development practices, including data preparation, feature engineering, model evaluation, performance testing, version control, and reproducible experimentation
 Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams and communicate technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders
 Secret clearance
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or Statistics
 
 Nice If You Have: 
 Experience developing or deploying AI capabilities in cloud, edge, disconnected, degraded, intermittent, or bandwidth-limited environments
 Experience with generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, computer vision, natural language processing, speech processing, multimodal models, or autonomous systems
 Experience optimizing models for GPUs, embedded processors, mobile devices, or other resource-constrained computing platforms
 Experience with MLOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, model monitoring, data lineage, or automated testing
 Knowledge of responsible AI, model assurance, cybersecurity controls, data provenance, hallucination mitigation, and AI evaluation methods
 Ability to translate mission needs into technical requirements, experimentation plans, system architectures, and measurable evaluation criteria
 Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field preferred; Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field a plus
 
 Clearance: 
 Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.
 
 Compensation 
 At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.
 
Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date. 
 Identity Statement 
 As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.
 
 Candidate AI Usage Policy 
 AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided . 

 Work Model 
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.
 Remote : If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
 Hybrid : If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
 Onsite : If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.
 
 Commitment to Non-Discrimination 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.
